_note: Which deployment each station's desktop app points at. Not a Tauri config —
tauri.conf.json rejects unknown keys, so this can't live in the station
profiles under src-tauri/stations/ and sits here instead.
The URL is a station's own running instance of the web app: the desktop app
is a window onto it, and every listing, audio file and image still goes
through that server's proxies. It is NOT where installers are downloaded
It lives in git rather than in an Actions variable for two reasons: one
variable cannot serve N stations, and when a host changes, a commit records
when and why. A manual workflow run can still override it from the input box
Baked in at compile time — changing a URL means rebuilding, not a setting.
